title: Where Would You End Up If You Fell Through Earth?
summary: Imagine a tunnel straight through the centre of the Earth, with no air in it. If you jumped in, where would you stop? A thought experiment with real physics.

beats.text: What if you jumped into a tunnel straight through the Earth? Would you stop in the middle, pop out the other side, or fall forever?
Imagine a tunnel with no air, so nothing slows you down. Gravity pulls you towards the centre.
Time's up. Where do you end up?
beats.reveal: You reach the other side, stop for a moment, and fall back. You swing like a pendulum!

beats.text: You speed up all the way to the centre, then slow down on the far half.
Bonus fact: the whole trip takes under an hour, one way. Then you fall right back.

visual.text: In theory, the fall to the other side takes less than an hour.
